description: Change the checks counted in code, as the Problems page does: the token limit per turn (token_budget_enabled, max_tokens_per_turn) and the unanswered messages check (no_answer_enabled). Give only what changes; the rest stays. They apply to conversations judged from now on. Read them first with get_checks.

max_tokens_per_turn.description: The most tokens one turn may use before it is reported.
max_tokens_per_turn.title: Max Tokens Per Turn

no_answer_enabled.description: Report a conversation whose last message got no reply (on by default).
no_answer_enabled.title: No Answer Enabled

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

token_budget_enabled.description: Turn the token limit per turn on or off. On needs max_tokens_per_turn, given now or set before.
token_budget_enabled.title: Token Budget Enabled

name: set_checks
